metadata.purpose: Emit the first source value whose indexed predicate is truthy; emit undefined if the source completes without a match.

cardinality.signature: find : (T! x Index! -> Boolean!) -> T* -> T?
conditions: At most one source value is emitted; a finite no-match source emits one undefined value then completes.
First truthy result short-circuits source work.
Cω counts next values; terminal notifications, cancellation and resource release are separate obligations.

scope.parameters: Required predicate; deprecated thisArg and BooleanConstructor specialization excluded from the canonical profile.
scope.callbacks: One correlated predicate(value,index,source) outcome per tested value; source object identity is runtime-tested separately.
scope.time: No timer; source order determines predicate index and first-match selection.
scope.reentrancy: One pending predicate outcome at a time; source events during Calling are outside the non-reentrant profile.
exclusions: Deprecated thisArg overload, arbitrary predicate reentry, observer/finalizer exceptions.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire one source subscription only when the result is subscribed.

ownership.sharing: No sharing is introduced; each result subscription owns independent state and resources.
ownership.reset: A fresh result subscription starts from Unsubscribed; Closed rejects all later model events.

resources.owner: one invocation per tested source value

dispatch.actionSemantics: Commit next state, then interpret ordered actions. Callback actions are requests to external user functions, never executed by the pure model.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between fully resolved reactions; cancellation releases owned work and emits no synthetic completion.
